messages:
Rae (Docs): Opening a tiny PR to update the model-catalog entry for 'glade-6b' — need to add migration notes for the new slug and fix an incorrect bench link. Anyone able to quick-review?

Owen (ML): I can look. What bench link is broken?

Rae (Docs): The card links to /bench/glade-old-stats which 404s. The new page is /bench/glade-6b-v1. Also want to add a note that the q4_0 quant variant reduces throughput on sequence lengths >2048.

Priya (SDK): I noticed SDK examples still reference `model: 'glade'`. We should update to the canonical `glade-6b` and show both generate and embeddings snippets. Draft Node embed snippet: ```js
const r = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'glade-6b', input: ['a','b'] })
```
I'll push that to the PR.

Rae (Docs): Thanks. Can you also add a one-line migration tip: "If you used slug 'glade' previously, update to 'glade-6b' or configure an alias. See infra redirect note."

Ben (Infra): I can add a redirect from /models/glade -> /catalog/models/glade-6b. Filing infra-redirects#81 and will deploy a 301 shortly.

DocsBot: PR #4278 lint: model card requires a short compat note for quant variants and an examples block with at least one Python snippet.

Priya (SDK): Adding Python snippet too (aiohttp example) and a small comment about batching shards for embeddings.

Owen (ML): About the q4_0 note: recommend text: "q4_0: optimized for memory, may show reduced throughput for seq_len > 2048; prefer q8 for long-context workloads."

Rae (Docs): Perfect. I'll add that and update the bench link. Waiting on Ben for redirect before merging so old links don't break.

Ben (Infra): Redirect deployed (301).

Rae (Docs): CI green after Priya's snippet changes. Merged PR #4278. Added short release-note entry and pinged support. Closing thread. :tada:
